newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Foreign investment in Bulgaria $452 mln in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Bulgaria $452 mln in 1995.

text.p: Foreign investment in Bulgaria totalled $452 million last year, the National Statistic Institute (NSI) said on Thursday.
"A statistics survey showed that investment in the country last year totalled $452 million," said the NSI in a statement.

The biggest foreign investors are Germany with 32 percent of all investments and Britain with 16.2 percent, the United States with seven percent and Greece with 6.3 percent among others. Foreign companies focus on industrial investment with 44.3 percent, transport with 25.9 percent and trade with 20 percent, said the NSI.
The survey did not show foreign investment from the previous year.
Direct foreign investment in Bulgaria for the first nine months of 1996 stood at $201 million, double the level for the same period last year, deputy prime minister Roumen Gechev said a week ago.
